blocks.text: Farm Fresh advanced to the finals of the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Siklab series finals after surviving top seed Nxled, 26-24, 25-16, 23-25, 17-25, 15-11, in Game 2 of the semifinals on Thursday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
